changes: Persons, relation and date are confirmed unchanged.

Notes refined: the chapter name 'mutha(!)hāphalādhyāyaḥ' reads as Muthahā-/Munthāphalādhyāya. It does not match the catalogue title Ariṣṭabhaṅgādhyāya. The Naukā is Viśvanātha's commentary on the Varṣatantra.

notes: This is only the text's chapter colophon. It names the author of the Naukā, Viśvanātha Daivajña, son of Divākara Daivajña; the Naukā is a commentary on the Varṣatantra. 'varṣataṃtraraukāyāṃ' should read 'varṣatantranaukāyāṃ'. 'mutha (!) hāphalādhyāyaḥ' is probably Muthahāphalādhyāyaḥ (Munthā-phala chapter). That does not match the catalogue title Ariṣṭabhaṅgādhyāya, so the catalogue title or the quoted colophon may come from a different chapter. The colophon gives no scribe, date, place or owner.
